claims.requirement: listCatalog(records, options) returns exactly {items,total,nextOffset}, where items is an array of copied records, total is the count of all filtered records, and nextOffset is a nonnegative integer or null.
Filtering preserves input order, category is an exact string match, and query is a case-insensitive name substring.
offset defaults to 0 and limit defaults to 20; the returned page uses filtered records at offset and at most limit records, and an exhausted page has nextOffset null.
A limit of zero returns items [] and nextOffset null while total remains the complete filtered count.
offset and limit must be safe nonnegative integers; invalid values reject before records are read or mutated.
The input record array and record objects remain unchanged, and modifying returned records cannot change input records.
